notes.title: Update 4 - Roguelite Endless Mode - Out Now!
notes.notes:
It's here. [i]Praise METEM.[/i] Right on top of the [i]Actu Gaming French Direct![/i]

Without further ado, here's [b]Update 4[/b], including the [i]Roguelite Endless Mode[/i] we've been excited to share with you, along with new perks and abilities! And a seriously long list of bug fixes... (see below)

Again [b]Special Thanks[/b] to the Void Crew community for all their feedback! Here’s a recap of the big headlines, in a 'new player' friendly video:

[previewyoutube=guE8Shsvab4;full][/previewyoutube]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43802314/770fe3bd55610530157daf19a29e8df49f4f6357.png[/img]

[h1]Roguelite Endless mode![/h1]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/yoMRCcT.gif[/img]
What is more to say? [i]Go try it out![/i] 

Getting Endless to work required a lot of work, including [b]rework of the Astral map[/b] to show various stages and rewards during an endless run, while still being compatible with the standard pilgrimages.

We also wanted to give players tangible [b]rewards after each objective[/b], so players would get some power progression at least... but time your exit if you want to grab that delicious Void Jumping Supply Drop! And you better not forget it, cause those enemies will keep coming and they keep getting more nasty! Even Proximity mines won't go down with one shot after a few jumps...

And if that wasn't all, endless mode supports [b]stacking of twists[/b] in a single sector! Combined with [b]dynamic support of changing solar system[/b] in an Endless run means you'll never be quite sure of what will come your way...

And it wouldn't be a [i]Roguelite[/i] if we didn't make sure you'd have to adapt your strategy for every run... so your [b]fabrication options will be limited[/b]! But we are sure you'll make the best of it. Or die trying. Probably the latter.

[h2]Leveling Revamp[/h2]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/espr8Hg.gif[/img]
We've kept the 'capped' 30 ranks, and named those [b]Ascension Ranks[/b]: Basically finite levels of worthiness of METEM. The purpose of Ascension ranks is to ease players in, unlocking content as they progress.

But how do you show off how cool you reaaaally are? That's where the infinite [b]METEM Favor Levels[/b] come in! After capping your Ascension Rank, you start earning Favor Levels. Now you can truly show who should be the Captain...

[i]And don't forget: Each rank up - for both types - grants you a cosmetic box. Milestone ranks grant higher tiers of cosmetics boxes - with improved duplicate protection![/i]

[h2]Perks and Abilities[/h2]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/wTn17kG.gif[/img]
[i]First[/i] things first - we had to change how Gene Points work - They are now finite, and you get one per Ascension Rank. 

[i]IMPORTANT! What about all your hard-earned [b]Gene Points[/b]? Worry not - Your collected Gene Points will be converted into generous XP - you can claim those XP in the Personal Loadout Terminal![/i]

[i]Secondly[/i], we love the idea of multi-speccing, so now you can spend points in all classes. You can spec deep or broad it is all up to you!

[i]Thirdly[/i], there are now THREE types of things you can invest your gene points into: Perks, Blueprints and Abilities. Lets see what each class is offered:

[h3]The Gunner[/h3]
The Gunner gets access to perks that buff their ability to damage whoever stands in your way. And you'll need it! But of course, choice will have to be made: Do you opt for Energy damage? Kinetic? Or a lower but shared damage buff. Range? Firerate? Accuracy?

The [b]blueprint[/b] available to the gunner is higher tier weapon mods, otherwise unavailable in Endless mode.

The Gunner's special ability is their [b]Empower Weapon[/b], which deals [b][i]super-effective[/i][/b] damage no matter the type of armor or shield the enemy has!

[h3]The Pilot[/h3]
The Pilot tree perks buff their ability to maneuver their ship, but also ability to charge void drive faster, longer lasting Thruster Boosts and more resilient shields to keep the ship intact for as long as it takes!

The Pilot gets blueprint access to a module which grants additional Thruster Boosts! Of course you'll have to convince your crew that is a sane investment...

The Pilot's special ability is their [b]Empower Ship[/b], which almost instantly gain omnidirectional protection... great for when you get into a tight spot!

[h3]The Engineer[/h3]
The Engineer has some interesting perks, like the [i]Magnetic Boots[/i], limiting floating up into the air on ship power loss and be less affected by that pilot who pulls the Void Lever prematurely... yeah you know that person!

The Engineer gets the blueprint which allows fabricating the very expensive Ship System Upgrader... a very lucrative item indeed for those seeking higher tier modules...

Is the Ship falling apart again? Well, the Engineer will save you with their [b]Repair Instinct[/b] that makes them run faster and instantly repair stuff!

[h3]The Scavenger[/h3]
Of course the Scavenger gets perks suited for exploration and for those long-walks in EVA. One team favorite is the Long Throw perk, allowing charging up to throw that valuable loot back to the ship.

The Scavenger gets the blueprint to fabricate the Oxygenated Blood Pack, a tiiiiiny syringe-like item which grants additional oxygen and health on those long space walks. And it is okay to share too!

But where the Scavenger really shines is their fancy new [b]Grappling Hook[/b], making them the fastest Ectype out there...


Whatever your choice, we are sure you'll have a better chance of surviving with than without!


[h2]All the other (important) stuff![/h2]

[h3]Immersive Vivox Voice Chat[/h3]
[previewyoutube=bb6O4FZZRxk;full][/previewyoutube]
This takes immersion to a new level. The Pilot talks through speakers around ship, EVA'ing Ectypes talk through “radio with static noise effect”, and voice is manipulated based on proximity to source. Of course it comes with the option to disable in the settings if you aren't into immersion and stuff.

[h3]Co-op drama[/h3]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/TMwy4Q1.gif[/img]
These things just add up (in a good way). Here's a simple overview of what to look out for:
[list]
[*] Salute with gesture and voice to praise METEM!
[*] Due to various reported airlock accidents occurring on METEM ships, High Command decided to re-direct the suits built-in C02 exhausts to eject with body movement, resulting in natural forward movement when Ectypes are in No Gravity Zones, like space: what we call, "Space Swimming". Losing power and engaging Void Jump will make your ship a No Gravity Zone, so careful now!
[*] Tactile hands shows animations when repairing defects
[*] Player core animations have received an overhaul
[*] Inverse Kinematic driven hands have been implemented (to show carryables in hands)
[/list]
[h3]Controller support (BETA)[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43802314/8a822f4accf3321ab2dd9fa27c62d8c31b3cd3b3.png[/img]
We thought we get it out there sooner than later, so try out our Beta version and give us feedback on our [url=https://discord.gg/joinvoidcrew][b]Discord[/b][/url]!

[h3]Volumetric lights[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43802314/702e83f19a79bf9e9da2277d79568d92cde11109.png[/img]
Mmmmm... so pretty! God rays, moody interiors and unexplained light sources is all we are saying.

[h3]New Cosmetics[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43802314/ffbdd5f1701877922b3f01e13392fa0a0e6e305e.png[/img]
A few more cosmetics for the fashionable Ectype, including a 'winged' chestpiece, patterns and colorful... ehm... colors.

notes.title: Roguelite Endless Mode - Update 4
notes.notes:
We are releasing [b]Update 4[/b], the [b]biggest[/b], [b]most curated and most game-changing[/b] Update for Void Crew so far! As in ... [b][i]veeeery shortly! You can hold your breath! *[/i][/b]

[i]* For medical reasons, don't actually hold your breath.[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43802314/f61381aaded974d0c8225588f127d6cda088e7f5.png[/img]

Here’s a sneak preview of what’s to come, but as already disclosed in the recent [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1063420/view/4182229929071520457]Spacelog[/url], Update 4 contains a TON of new stuff!

So in short, what exactly is coming? Here's a small teaser video:

[previewyoutube=SXg1palOsvM;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]Roguelite Endless Mode[/h2]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/BEKwXEi.gif[/img]
[i]^Serene GIF to prepare you and your crew for impending doom...[/i]

Yes, we can't stop saying this enough. This means the adventure DOES NOT RESET until you decide to (to cash in XP) ... or you get yourself into too much trouble!

We wanted players to try it out so badly, we allowed a select few from the community to have a go at an early version (bugs and all!) - here's what they said: 
[quote=Players][i]"Endless mode is a lot of fun and it was cool to see what was around every corner."

"The new endless mode is very fun! It's a bit difficult at the start with the lack of perks*, but getting longer and longer runs gives a good sense of progression."

"Really digging this new endless mode as well. Really excited for the full release of Update 4. Keep up the good work!"[/i][/quote]
This includes things like ever increasing enemy difficulty, objective specific rewards that scale based on the challenge of selected objective and so on ... We can't wait to have everyone try it out!

[i]* New accounts were used to also evaluate the new leveling experience[/i]

[h2]Ectype Perks and Ability[/h2]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/DL1mYSm.gif[/img]
[i]^ Soo many options![/i]

So here it is - the first batch of player perks, along with a unique ability for each Ectype role! Lots of perks to enhance your playstyle, and mix between the different trees as you like. But, the true identifier is which ability you will pick:

[b]Gunner:[/b] [i]Empower weapon[/i] to deal [b][i]super-effective[/i][/b] damage no matter the type of armor or shield the enemy has!

[b]Engineer:[/b] Ship falling apart again? Channel your [i]Repair Instinct[/i] to run faster and instantly repair stuff!

[b]Pilot:[/b] [i]Empower Ship[/i] to instantly gain omnidirectional protection ... great for when you get into a tight spot!

[b]Scavenger:[/b] [i]Grappling Hook[/i] your way around town like nobody's bu .... ehm ... Tarzan(?)

One player expressed this:
[quote=Player][i]"The new abilities are awesome as well, making each class feel even more their own while also allowing for that little bit of overlap. [...] I think you nailed the new system and I look forward to seeing the missing perks."[/i][/quote]
[h2]What else?[/h2]
Did we mention we've [i]fixed over ~255 issues[/i]? Yes, we are still in EA and there will be bugs, but we acknowledge that bugs do diminish the overall experience and we can't have that!

Also ... We admit it. Again. We can't help it! We miiight have gotten a bit ambitious here. We thought it would be better to get these features into the hands of players sooner than later, so here's a bunch of headlines of included stuff:

[list]
[*]New finite [b]Ascension Ranks[/b] and infinite [b]Metem Favor[/b] ranks
[*]Various new [b]Social features[/b] (Salute, Tactile hands, Animations & IK, etc)
[*]New [b]Immersive Voice Chat[/b]
[*]New [b]Controller [/b]support (BETA)
[*]New support for [b]Simplified Chinese[/b] (BETA)
[*]New support for [b]Russian [/b](BETA)
[*]Various [b]UX [/b]and [b]QoL [/b]fixes - [i]thanks Community![/i]
[/list]

Stay tuned for the FULL LIST of changes and bug fixes in the Update article we release on the day of the update.

[i]Join our [url=https://discord.gg/joinvoidcrew]Discord[/url] for more news, and don’t forget to tune in to read the full changelog.[/i]

[i]Sincerely,

notes.title: Dev Stream #9 - Highlights (with Update 4 Sneak Peeks!)
notes.notes:
Hey ectypes!

Highlights from our [b]Dev Stream #9[/b] are up! And if you're interested on knowing what's going to come with Update 4, you have to watch this one (or scroll down for a written summary!)

[b]Watch the Highlights video here (including the Update 4 sneak peeks):[/b]
[previewyoutube=inObL4JzqfY;full][/previewyoutube]

If you want to watch the full stream, you can do that here: 
https://youtu.be/YZQBRVznhrk

[h1]WHAT IS COMING ON UPDATE 4?[/h1]

[h2]Overhaul of the progression system[/h2]
The new system will bring things more in line with how the lootboxes are given out, and also will give more usability to gene points - in the current state of the game, when players get a lot of gene points they end up not having anything to do with them.

Players will have their gene points that they'll be able to distribute amongst the different perk trees, [b]allowing dual spec[/b] if they want to do that, or [b]diving deep into a specific perk tree[/b]. This will also come with a [b]huge perk tree rework[/b].

[h2]Class-specific abilities[/h2]
These abilities are something that will [b]enhance the class identity[/b], and give you a moment were you feel like super cool and bringing super extra to the team - like some kind of "ultimate" abilities. 

You [b]can only choose one of them[/b], but it will really [b]supercharge[/b] whatever your character is good at. Right now they're at a prototype stage: they'll have a cooldown and recharge over time, but of course we'll look into how you charge them, how long they last, how effective they are, etc. 

We'll also look into what they do - some of them might be too fun to just keep them tied to a single perk tree, and we might want to make them more widely available.

An [b]example [/b]of ability that we're playing with (but might not make it into release, so take it with a pinch of salt!) is a Gunner ability that would allow them to temporarily change the damage type of the weapon they're currently using, making it bypass all kinds of checks (shields, etc).

[h2]Endless mode[/h2]
We're working very hard on this. We think we'll make it so the endless mode is a choice you can make while still keeping the current pilgrimages - we're trying to support both rather than substituting pilgrimages with the new system right away. This is mainly because the [b]endless mode is something we'll have to work a lot on, in terms of balancing and polishing[/b] - so we don't want to diminish the game by pilgrimages being removed, but rather you can choose to try an endless run or play a pilgrimage.

Endless mode calls for a [b]new approach to how rewards are given out, and how power progression works[/b] during the session. With Endless Mode, [b]objectives come with a in-run reward[/b], and you'll be able to do [b]multiple objectives where you can choose from one or another[/b] - your objective choice will be about what you're going to get on your ship as the next reward. So you can maybe chose an easy objective that will give you like a mine field summoning shard, but you can also chose to go for a very hard objective that will give you maybe an epic turret as a permanent installation on your ship for that run, for example.

[b]We're in the early days of developing this, and we have to figure out how it plays best[/b] - but the idea is that you can do [b]very long runs with scaling difficulty[/b] and seeing if you can actually get the ship to be able to withstand the difficulty increase. This will bring the game closer to that "[b]roguelite with friends[/b]" feeling, which was the original vision that Daniel had when he sat down and started thinking about Void Crew back in the days.

[h2]Tactile mechanics and hand animations[/h2]
We've already talked about introducing emotes in the past. How could would it be to salute your fellow ectypes? You'll be able to!

One of the pillars that we have when designing Void Crew is [b]tactile interactions[/b]; the idea that you're logging things around and placing them down. But that tactility, the presence of your hands in the game, has been missing. There's a few interactions and animations with hands that are visible, specially when you watch other players - but we wanted to bring that even more forward, and [b]getting the hands in play[/b]. This will be both when [b]interacting with the world[/b] (there will be hands animations when you do stuff around!), and also for [b]emotes[/b]; when you do emotes you'll be able to see your hands animated, on top of the 3rd person animation that other players will see.

We're working on foundational tech for this. This wasn't only about the saluting emote, but also unlocking Daniel E., our CG Artist, to do [b]more fun animations with the hands and improve how ectypes interact with the world[/b].

Laurids, as our Lead Designer (and one of our resident loot goblins), mentioned he can see the ability to get unique hand gestures through the reward pools, that players can unlock and then maybe even get a full-on emote wheel. [i]He also mentioned he wanted the exclusive ability to flip the bird on people, but let's not talk too much about that...[/i]

[h2]Swimming on zero gravity[/h2]
The idea of getting blown out of the airlock was always part of the "core fantasy" of things going wrong in Void Crew. But specially in single player, when it happens it also feels like [i]"okay, this is fun, but it's also a bit sad that I lost agency"[/i]. So we wanted to go ahead and [b]give ectypes the ability to "swim" on zero gravity situations[/b]. So, if you get thrown out of the airlock without EVA, you will be able to swim around in space - full-on hands animations and everything! It does look ridiculous, but in the good way. And it means that in those situations, you will be able to try and swim back to the ship. Keep in mind the [b]swimming is slow[/b], though - if you have a pilot that doesn't like you and keeps driving away, you won't be able to get back in. You'll have to coordinate!

This also unlocked another thing for us: [b]we can turn off gravity inside of the ship[/b]... in certain circumstances. No spoilers on that yet, sorry! [i]We have to keep some secrets[/i]. 

When there's no gravity on the ship, you'll be floating around and will have to swim down to the floor before you can move again. While we can't talk much about this yet, Javier mentioned that the first time we tried this internally was the time he laughed the most playing Void Crew... so keep an eye out for this!

[i]How hard do you have to get hit by a carriable before you actually take damage?[/i] This is something we'll have to evaluate at some point, because it's happening now...

[h2]Making ectype deaths funnier[/h2]
Let's be honest... we all laugh when someone on our crew dies in the most ridiculous way. And while it's still fun for the person dying as well, we want to make it better. We're experimenting with this and trying to make it so [b]you can see your own death[/b] instead of your screen getting blocked automatically and going back to the sarcograph. We want you to be able to laugh with your crew!

While we're trying very hard to get this into Update 4, we can't 100% assure it - but we're definitely working on it!

As Daniel E. said... [i]any chance to improve dying is an improvement to fun[/i]. He subscribes to that idea, and we do as well!


Hope you like what's coming to Void Crew! Let us know what you're more excited about in the comments. And, as always...
[h3]Metem preserve you![/h3]

[i]With love,
The Hutlihut Games team[/i]

notes.notes:
[b]Special Thanks[/b] goes out to the Void Crew community (again!) for all their feedback and good vibes!

This Update brings a lot of fixes, quality of life additions, new content and community requests - Basically stuff across the board, and without doubt [b]our biggest update to date![/b]

Here’s a recap of what’s new:

[previewyoutube=I7cQ6UQJJOs;full][/previewyoutube]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43802314/770fe3bd55610530157daf19a29e8df49f4f6357.png[/img]


[h2]More Upgrade Steps![/h2]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/KNI2XRZ.gif[/img]
Ectypes need all the help they can get to fight off the HOLLOW! The Ship [b]System Upgrader[/b] was lacking upgrade steps for a handful of Ship Systems - these have now been added, allowing you to push the offensive power of your ship even higher. Upgrade steps were added for these system:

[*] B.R.A.I.N. turret now has 3 Marks
[/list]
[i]* The tech controlling the Gravity Scoop's attraction beam has also been updated to be more stable and reliable.[/i]


[h2][Community] New Ship Loadout: [i]“Freedom”[/i][/h2]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/A5tarWr.gif[/img]
A recurring Community Request, this Update also introduces the [b]Freedom Loadout[/b] for the Destroyer and Frigate, taking the place of the CQB II loadout. This new (experimental) option starts you off with a blank ship and a handful of Animus Crates!
[b]Note[/b]: To unlock this loadout, you need at least one crew member at Ectype Rank 24* or higher. With the [b]Ship System Upgrader[/b] addition, we're shifting from Tiered Loadouts to instead relying on acquiring the System Upgrader during Pilgrimages.

[spoiler][i]* Rank, Progression and Perks are being redesigned for an upcoming update 🙂[/i][/spoiler]


[h2][Community] Reward Overhaul[/h2]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/CXfv9UB.gif[/img]
We've improved control on how we hand out rewards to Players - and how the rarity of the Loot Boxes is tied to the aggressiveness of the built-in duplicate protection. The standard [b]Common Loot Box[/b] come with "pretty good" duplicate protection, but doesn't have improved chances to drop higher rarities. [b]Higher rarity boxes[/b] will guarantee higher rarity loot and more aggressive duplicate protection. [b]Seasonal Loot Boxes[/b] are so aggressively guarding against duplicates, that once you've collected all common items, they'll start handing out rares. This means that the Seasonal Boxes can be trusted to reward you all the items from their designated Reward Pool, as long as you keep collecting them. We call the "new" Loot Boxes [b]Gifts of METEM[/b], and are continuing to tweak the experience.

[b]Gifts of METEM[/b] are earned and tallied during Pilgrimages, but must be opened from the new [b]Rewards tab[/b] on the Personal Loadout Terminal. This means the End-of-Pilgrimage flow has been shortened significantly, but also allows us to do more interesting things with handing out Rewards in the future.

In addition to the new Rewards Tab, the Personal Loadout Terminal now also shows both Name as well as Rarity for items you've collected.

The Update also contains three new Armor Pieces, as well as a handful of Projections.

[h2][Community] Uncapped FPS[/h2]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/rlDf4ZA.gif[/img]
We've rewritten how the character interacts with the ship physics, uncapping their movement from the tick-rate of the physics engine. In simple terms, this should smooth out the camera movement. This is of course part of a larger overhaul, so expect more improvements to this in upcoming updates. [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1063420/view/3886107476402125362]Read more about the topic here[/url].


[h2]Secrets from the Past…[/h2]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/OBVlREt.gif[/img]
[i]Vestiges of a bygone age, the derelict wrecks of the Void abound with valuable secrets and stories untold. Lore scholars and inquisitive souls should be on the lookout for Data Terminals. These troves of ancient knowledge dispense special Data Shards stuffed with ship reports, combat logs, and other invaluable snippets of narrative intel. Bring the Shards back to the Astral Map for decryption and unlock new Codex Entries. Only then may we begin to glimpse the greater picture…[/i]

Simply put: [b]Collectable story chapters[/b] found on Space Bases and Wrecks, each unlocking entries in the Codex about the Void Crew universe.


[h2]Topic of Love[/h2]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/e9kKe9I.gif[/img]
A new time limited enemy has been added: [b]The Lovelorn Collector[/b] - this lovesick enemy is hoarding unique Data Shards, pilfered from METEM's devotees. Bring these special Data Shards back to the Astral Map, and you're rewarded a Devotional Gift of METEM!

Open your Devotional Gift of METEM in the Personal Loadout Terminal, and earn season-appropriate rewards, including a new special helmet, or even a set of heartfelt shoulder pads.

METEMs R&D department has gone all in this time around, ensuring various modules can now be upgraded when a Ship System Upgrader comes your way. This will surely help you battle the newly discovered Elite versions of the HOLLOW Sniper and Bomber. 

Included in the upgradeable modules are - amongst favorites - the monstrous Recuser Beamcaster Mk III, the Quad barrelled Litany Minigun MK III, the relentless B.R.A.I.N. Mk III and even the unquelching Gravity Scoop* Mk III with 6 scoop-slots!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/wgHhQfF.gif[/img]
With the CQB II being retired by the introduction of the Ship System Upgrader, we saw an opportunity to do something "Experimental". So, yes, rejoice, now high ranked members of staff are now able to select the "[i]Freedom[/i]"-class Frigate or Destroyer ships with no modules installed! This is a community request we see as something we are going to try out together.

[h3]Loot overhaul[/h3]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/AFthvIV.gif[/img]
We've reworked how we reward players: We've improved control on how we give loot (ie cosmetics) to players, adding duplicate protection logic and drop chance (introducing proper rarity). And also, we added more stuff.

[h3]Uncapped FPS[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43802314/ea52b23070dd460060fd6f98f74ed50d9c5827b2.png[/img]
You read it right. We've rewritten how the character interacts with the ship physics making their movement uncapped from the tick-rate of the physics engine. The ship itself will still need a bit more work for its movement to also be uncapped, but rest assured it is something we will also address in one of the upcoming updates. Give it a spin and let us know! [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1063420/view/3886107476402125362]Read more about the topic here[/url].

[h2]Lore collectibles[/h2]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/jJ85Qjd.gif[/img]

[h2]Month of Stars and Love[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43802314/d8630e88771a2fe05d51f2ad98b94f727b25d267.png[/img]
With so much love from the community, there is no chance we could resist the time-limited opportunity - Go hunt for the rare and illusive Lovelorn Collectors to get the themed cosmetic while available!

[h2]What else?[/h2]

We admit it. We feature creeped a lot on this update. Not only did we do all the above, we also did a TON of fixes. We can sleep when we are old.

Since this is only a [b]PREVIEW[/b], stay tuned for the FULL LIST of changes and bug fixes in the Update article we release on the day of the update!

[i]Join our [url=https://discord.gg/joinvoidcrew]Discord[/url] for more news, and don’t forget to tune in on [b]Thursday 15th of February[/b] to read the full changelog.[/i]

[i]With Love,
Hutlihut Games Crew

[h1]Happy Holidays! We have something special in store for you![/h1]
[b]Special thanks[/b] goes out to the Void Crew community for all their feedback and good vibes!

We have been collecting feedback from the [b]COMMUNITY[/b], and in this update the focus is on addressing some of those requests/wishlists! Here’s a recap of what’s new:

[h2]Void Jump Revamp and Astral Map[/h2]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/RFFeYNT.gif[/img]

Some peace and quiet is a welcome gift for any stressed-out Ectype. The Institute of Ectype Mental Health found that prolonged downtime in the Void Jump Tunnel could help Ectypes prepare - mentally and physically - for their next challenge*. To further decrease self-Biomassification to acceptable levels, all Astral Map Terminals have been updated to the latest OS with new user friendliness, iconography and motivational colors**.

[i]* Leaving the ship during the Void Jump still results in a guaranteed uneventful death. We're discussing providing a risk/reward scenario for letting Ectypes repair Hull Breaches inside the Void Tunnel.
** ... Objectives are laid out in a sequential manner on the Map, which also forms the UX basis for navigating longer Pilgrimages with more Objectives.[/i]


[h2]Graded Enhancements[/h2]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/1VULSh3.gif[/img]

Ship System Enhancements have gotten a pass, making them much more powerful, but also more temperamental. Flubbing an Enhancement Boost will put the Enhancement into a temporary [i]Failure State[/i], which temporarily debuffs the targeted system.

Engineer-specced Ectypes, however, have also seen some love. The Engineer Perk Tree* has been extended with a new branch containing three Enhancement-related Perks, allowing engineers to override the Failure State, as well as buffing the Duration and Effect of Enhancements to levels above those achievable by non-Engineers..

So... remember to PRAISE your fellow Engineer - they have feelings too, surprisingly.

[i]* The Perk Tree system is scheduled for an overhaul in the near future.[/i]

[h2]Ship System Upgrader MkI[/h2]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/vNs4AmB.gif[/img]

The Department of Armament has sent out a broadcast to all Ectypes to look out for a new carrayble object, namely the [i]"Ship System Upgrader MkI"[/i]. It's a versatile little Item which allows Ectypes to point and click to [i]upgrade ship systems[/i] to one Mark higher. This works for both pre-installed Ship Systems as well as the ones fabricated via Animus Crates*.

[i]* Not all Ship Systems have upgrade paths at this time.[/i]

[h2]Void Jump Interdiction[/h2]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/Tm01uhU.gif[/img]

The Void Jump is not without peril - the HOLLOW have developed a machine to yank us out of the sanctuary that is the Void - the [b]Interdiction Pillar[/b]. With a steady drum, it tears at the stability of the Void Tunnel, eventually forcing it to collapse, and for the Ship to emerge into a hostile ambush. If the Pillar wasn't enough, several new enemies are thrown into the fray - for example the Shield Generator, which will bestow shields on nearby HOLLOW Units.*
The Interdiction Pillar floats at the center of a large debris field - Victims of prior ambushes. Look for the METEM Wrecks within, as they're likely to contain worthwhile loot.

[i]* Interdictions can happen once per Pilgrimage, and the risk escalates for each Void Jump. We're evaluating the mechanics and difficulty of the Encounter.[/i]

[h2]New "Shade" Armor Cosmetics[/h2]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/HeSKah2.gif[/img]

A little something for the fashionable: The "Shade" Armor collection consists of a Helmet, Shoulderpads and Chestpiece - a must have for any respectable Ectype.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/NaI0Qty.gif[/img]

Our Community First Update 2 with a special layer of Holiday mood is dropping this [b]Thursday (14th of Dec 2023)[/b]!

Here’s a sneak preview of what’s to come:

[h2]Community First[/h2]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/fuJOzfI.gif[/img]

METEM’s Ectype Resource Department has been hard at work with local Ectypes (aka Players) to increase the chance of success on their Pilgrimages, and presents a series of initiatives on how you can best the HOLLOW. METEM Command takes your struggle seriously, and approves of several must-have-requests, including (but not limited to):

[list]
[*] [b]Engineering Role[/b]
The Engineering Perk Tree now sees a separate branch for using [b]Enhancements[/b] - Extend Duration, or Buff the Enhancement Effect even higher! (Unfortunately, tampering with the Enhancement Interface also comes with increased risk now. Fumbling an Enhancement will put it into a temporary Failure state. Engineer-Ectypes, however, can recover from the Failure state, while grumbling contemptuously to themselves, obviously.
[*] [b]Void Jump Revamp[/b]
The Void Jump has been split into two parts. Leaving (read: Escaping) the current Sector & Planning where to go next. While inside the Void Jump Tunnel, take as much time as you need to Repair Defects, Recycle Stuff and Blame each other for what went wrong. You have all the time in the world… Unless of course you get Interdicted!
[i]Dev Note: The Void Jump Revamp is the first step towards enabling longer Pilgrimages.[/i]
[*] [b]New Astral Map Interface[/b]
The Astral Map interface has been updated to accomodate the new Void Jump procedure. When in an Objective it provides a helpful recap of the current Objective, and allows Player to plot a Vector to leave the current Sector. Inside the [i]Void Jump Tunnel[/i], the Astral Map gives a more immersive overview of the Upcoming Objectives, as well as any side-objectives that might have appeared.
[*] [b]Ship System Upgrader MkI[/b]
A new Epic Carryable that can be used to upgrade an installed Ship System Module to a higher tier! This includes [i]any system[/i], pre-installed or the ones made from Animus Crates! The Ship System Upgrade can only be found as loot during a Pilgrimage, so make sure you stay in METEM’s good graces.
[*] … and more!
[/list]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/U6PoDm3.gif[/img]

The HOLLOW are escalating as well, this time bringing several new enemy down upon us! One [b]generates shields[/b] to nearby HOLLOWS, while another one … well making the Void Jump a safe space for players tempted the HOLLOW to make an enemy which [b]interdicts players while jumping[/b]!

This is our first Seasonal Event! You'll find a special Optional Objective temporarily added to the Pilgrimages. Completing this Objective ([i]on any difficulty[/i]) will net you a Seasonal "Festive Lootbox" containing time limited cosmetics.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/KxEFNAg.gif[/img]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/pMvznhN.gifhttps://i.imgur.com/pMvznhN.gif[/img]
METEM Pixelmancer staff have concluded their work on Shield UI Displays - for the time being. This means that interfaces displaying Energy Shields will have more clearly defined "layers" of protection and visualization of Shield Recharge rate. This should make it easier for Pilots and Engineers to see the status and efficiency of shipboard Shields.

However, all this work spent on the Shield screens meant that the hitpoint max of the shields was reduced by 50%. And also the shields were too good. Like, by a lot.

[h2]KPD update[/h2]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/UVeWcvg.gif[/img]
In addition, the METEM department of Defense felt a much needed bump in the standard issue Kinetic Point Defense modules (KPDs) was needed. After some tinkering, KPDs have been tuned to prioritize guided torpedos/missiles when acquiring a new target. Acquiring a target has also been drastically improved for each mark, so don't get your hopes too high for the mk I. Bullet consumption are now: KPD mk I: 10 bullets, KPD mk II: 20 bullets, KPD mk III: 25 bullets.


[h2]General Balancing / Tweaks[/h2]
Balancing is an ongoing process, and thanks to players we found a bunch of issues. A few noteworthy changes:
[list]
[*] Player shields max hitpoints was reduced by 50%, and battery consumption adjusted accordingly.
[*] Improved physics so players now inherit the ship’s speed more correctly, should now be possible to exit the ship while the ship is flying

[*] Improved lighting on characters
[*] Added sticky scanning - when scanning, target's marker should be forced visible
[*] Collectors should now roam correclty around the sectors
[*] Pressing P while having logbook opens, now closes it

We’ll evaluate these balancing tweaks and continue to fiddle with the numbers.

notes.title: B.R.A.I.N. Update 1.5 - Out Now!
notes.notes:
Another round of [b]special thanks[/b] goes out to the Void Crew community!

What’s new? Here’s a small recap of what’s new:

[previewyoutube=BKp_H5aGWVM;full][/previewyoutube]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43802314/770fe3bd55610530157daf19a29e8df49f4f6357.png[/img]

[h2][b]B.R.A.I.N.[/b]sssss...[/h2]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/EM2iheS.gif[/img]

A turret controlled by a [b]Bio-Robotic Automation Interfacing Neurosystem[/b] - or just [b]B.R.A.I.N.[/b] for short – the ultimate tool to assist smaller crews or the solo intrepid METEM explorer on their epic space journeys.

Due to the experimental nature of the [b]B.R.A.I.N.[/b]s, they're only available in the new frigate Loadout: The [b]Lone Sentry[/b], packed with two obedient [b]B.R.A.I.N.[/b]s* controlling a Benediction Mk II each. With its advanced laser targeting capabilities, [b]B.R.A.I.N.[/b] stands as your steadfast and efficient ally whenever duty calls. Experience the unwavering morale support of the one (or two) and only crewmate who never falters **, and let the prowess of Neuro-Computational Blackbox Algorithmic Advanced Automation handle the tasks (at the cost of most of your ship's power) while you focus on your urgent onboard responsibilities.

Or just sit in the pilot seat and [b]Target Lock[/b]*** any hostiles you want exterminated.

[i]* Due to the limitations of delicate biomass, the current B.R.A.I.N. availability is limited to the “Lone Sentry” loadout.
** Caution: While B.R.A.I.N. is exceptionally dependable, it is not intended to replace an actual crewmate, even if it does have a reputation for being a tad more reliable.
*** Yes, that is new as well… keep reading...[/i]

[h2]Pilot Target Locking, Aim Assist & Scanning[/h2]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/FGeG5VE.gif[/img]

A Pilot must keep their cool in the heat of battle, guiding their trigger happy gunners (be it brains or [b]B.R.A.I.N.[/b]s) to take out sneaky [b]Hollow Summoners[/b], prioritizing that [b]Prism Shield Node[/b], or track those near-invisible [b]Hollow Stealth Fighters[/b].

We are not saying that your pro gunners would need any help hitting their targets, of course, buuuut we should mention crewmates gain [b]Aim Assist[/b] on enemies that are [b]Target Locked[/b]! As you can figure, yes, this makes the role of pilot even more important for great collaboration.

However, [b]Target Locks[/b] requires the target to be scanned. [b]Scanning[/b] an object require either the players getting within a certain distance (depending on the object signature), or, a Pilot can target scan a specific objects within a few clicks! (Very useful for revealing unscanned loot...)

[h2]Cruise Mode[/h2]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/dyNvtPa.gif[/img]

Do you sometime feel you need to do everything yourself? Like charging the [b]Void Drive[/b] while [strike]fleeing[/strike] regrouping? Worry not! Right next to the Helm's power switch you'll notice the [b]Cruise Mode[/b] switch ([i]default shortcut key: Z[/i]) which will keep the ship going in whatever direction you want!

Various safety precautions ensure [b]Cruise Mode[/b] will not maroon you, unlike the (un)intentional actions of your crew.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43802314/f82823d06fb13a5ac951dab5148d9483296a0871.png[/img]
[list]
[*] Added force respawn in the ESC menu in case you get stuck in geometry (60s cooldown) [Early Access only]

notes.title: Quality of Life Update (0.21.1)
notes.notes:
[b]Special thanks [/b]to the Void Crew community who has already helped us improve the game with invaluable feedback!


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43802314/f82823d06fb13a5ac951dab5148d9483296a0871.png[/img]
[h2]Strike Objective[/h2]
Due to an anomaly in the Void, some objectives were statistically under-represented - this has been remedied and now one of our favourite objectives - Strike- will show up with the intended frequency! Strike comes in two variants - one being against the REMNANT faction and their reinforcement-calling comm-relays, the other against the massive HOLLOW Prism.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43802314/3023839191f2f5211c51607a0e9ce66c1572212f.jpg[/img]

[h2]Power Management[/h2]
Power management has seen a bump - now the circuit breakers will pop faster the more strain you add to the power grid - it’s no longer feasible to play Whack-a-Mole with a power overdraw of 400%!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/CqUnxBE.gif[/img]

[h2]Arc Shield - Part 1 (Part 2 scheduled for later update)[/h2]
Players brought to our attention that the Arc Shield modules were not performing as expected. After consulting the METEM Engineering staff, we can confirm that they were, in fact, not good. So we bumped them up - Shield-usage should now provide a significant increase in survivability. We also rebalanced the Power Cell effect and did a simple update to the shield UI gizmos. Note - this is part 1 of 2, as we intend to do a UX pass on the shield visualization so it’s easier to see the outcome of stacking shields. Stay tuned!

[h2]Accessibility[/h2]
Thanks again to the community for pointing out some usability issues:

[list]
[*] Added an option to [b]rebind (i)[/b] Invite and [b](p)[/b] Logbook ([b]for left handed players[/b])
[*] Added an option to [b]disable head bobbing[/b]
[*] Added [b]quality settings presets[/b]: Players can now choose between the quality settings presets
[*] Added [b]raised maximum mouse speed[/b] (this should not change your current setting)
[/list]
[h2]Ectype Portrait Gizmo and Rank widget[/h2]
[b]Animated Face Projections[/b] will now be animated in the Main HUD. [b]METEM Rank[/b] will also be shown in the UI - so you know that a lowbie Ectype has joined, and you need to take extra special care to not blow them out the airlock..

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43802314/f6aecee73c90d04b1f410058b0361a7ca748f2d4.gif[/img]
[h2]General Balancing[/h2]
Balancing is an ongoing process, and thanks to players we found a bunch of issues. A few noteworthy changes:
[list]
[*] HOLLOW Fighters and Heavy Fighters have had their “Red Laser” nerfed - this attack is meant to do consistent trickle-damage, but was really doing just a ton of damage.
[*] Hollow Heavy Fighters had their primary missiles attack tweaked - it now shoots two rockets instead of one, but their damage has been lowered - a good case for showing off your piloting dodging skills… or just let  the KPD deal with them.
[*] Arc Shields Mk I-III have been boosted (see above)
[*] The summoned METEM Escort Ship has had its alloy cost increased to 6. The summoned Escorts are very powerful, and while it’s super-cool to summon a fleet of them, they negatively affect the co-op nature of the game (Since they basically play the game for you). We scaled their cost to reflect that they’re an expensive boost for a single objective - and you should feel glad about finding the Shards as loot.
[*] The max number of HOLLOW Assembler Cores has been reduced to 3 when in a 4-player crew. The assemblers were basically flooding the sector with enemies.
[/list]

We’ll evaluate these balancing tweaks and continue to fiddle with the numbers.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43802314/f738146c8209c3946eae8f2c5c339e0c3afabca8.png[/img]We're fixing bugs as quickly as you guys can report them (We wish). Keep those bug reports coming, and we'll keep the fixes flowing:
